english: Uuuhn, it's been so long since I've been back!!
Feels a bit like coming home, doesn't it.
It really has been a while!\nThat welcome party back then\nwas so much fun...
We don't have the luxury\nof enjoying ourselves like last time, though.
Yes... you're right.
Tesla, Nine,\nplease explain the situation again.
Yes. Kei is after\nthe activation device for the satellite cannon Gustav,\nlocated in the Black Fund headquarters building.
Is this Gustav thing\nready to fire right away?
No-the Angel's Tear we sent to the Black Trader\nis hidden somewhere, and without it,\nit can't be activated.
Good, then we can relax a little.
What are you saying!\nIf Kei gets the Angel's Tear,\nit's all over!
So, what should we do?
About that-we'd like to neutralize Gustav\nby getting the Angel's Tear ourselves,\nif possible.
Why not go smash the activation device, nyo?
The Black Fund HQ building has a heavy defense system,\nso attacking it\nwould be high-risk.
Is that so? With my and Tsubasa-san's destructive power,\none building's no big deal, though?
If we stand out, Mii or Kei might show up.\nThen we'd be surrounded by enemies-\nthat could get bad.
Then, where is the Angel's Tear?
We'll have to investigate that.\nFather-the Black Trader-\nmust have hidden it somewhere.
That's... for us to search for...
Hold on-doesn't that mean\nthere's nothing for us to do?
Exactly.\nI can't agree to this plan!\nIt could still be a trap...
No! If we can't get\nthe Angel's Tear,\nthen we'll need your strength!
What proof do you have?\nYou think that'll make us believe you?
I haven't fully trusted them either.\nBut to avoid the worst-case scenario,\nwe have to do everything we can.
Reimu's right.\nKurumi-chan, they've got their shady parts,\nbut don't we have to cooperate for now?
...Kurumi-san.\nRight now, doubting them won't solve anything.\nCan't you believe in them?
Aoi Onee-sama... all right.\nBut if anything happens,\nI won't hold back...
I don't think Tesla-san and Nine-san\nare people who break promises.\nI believe in them.
Yeah, me too!\nThey delivered my Poketen, after all!
Tefa-san, Minazuki-san...
Just so you know, if you betray these kids' trust,\nyou won't get off easy.
I'll make you\nwish you were dead.\nBe prepared, okay?
Yes, I'll keep that in mind.
Preparation... complete.
(A tragic maiden is beautiful too, isn't she.\nMakes you want to protect her, doesn't it?)
(Can we really trust them...?)
(What worth is a man\nwho won't protect beautiful things?\nA man may be that simple.)
(Is that really true...)
Nyu? Don't you hear something, nyu?
Something's flying this way?\nEveryone! Stay alert!
//SE: explosion sound.
What was that, nyo!?
Haruka-chan, Aoi-chan, Kurumi-chan-\nhurry and go Twin Angel!
Yes!
//Haruka, Aoi, and Kurumi run offscreen.
Tsubasa-san... please!\nWe'll head out to intercept first!
Tsubasa-san! Please!!\nWe'll buy time!
Yes, I'm counting on you!
//Battle map: town (night).\n//Kei and grunts appear.\n//Forced deployment: Meru or Noel, Tsubasa, Tesla, Nine.
Arrived at target area.\nScan... no problems.
Waaah, it's back again!
It's that one!\nIt sniffed us out already!
But that may be proof the situation isn't bad.\nIf the Angel's Tear had been stolen,\nthey wouldn't come here...!
Still... safe...
Guess we're lucky-\nexcept for the part where we have to fight that thing!
Fear nothing!\nI, the Sakimori's sword, shall protect this world!
//Tsubasa transformation scene.\n//Tsubasa appears on the map.
Kei! I'll be your opponent!!
//Tesla and Nine also appear.
You won't be using Gustav!
...Absolutely... stop it.
Twin Phantom's hostile intent confirmed.\nBeginning elimination. Simultaneously\nprocessing acquisition of the bearer of nothingness as a task.
//Battle begins.\n//Talk event when Tsubasa and Kei clash.
A worthy opponent! Come!
Relic No. 1, Ame-no-Habakiri.\nActivated by song: phononic gain.\nPossesses unknown energy.
However, not a complete relic.\nInvestigation priority: low.
The Angel's Tear was a relic too.\nBut trying to compare things of different origins\nis a machine's bad habit!
Measuring energy values is valid data.\nComparison is possible.
Then take this!\nAll the resolve I've poured into this blade...!
//Talk event when Tesla and Kei clash.
Did you come to eliminate me and Nacchan?
Having contacted the enemy,\npunishment is only natural.\nDo you wish for clemency?
That's a bad joke!\nWe could never join hands\nwith those who would destroy our world!
Then we shall simply dispose of you.
//Talk event when Nine and Kei clash.
...Destruction... stop.
You have no decision-making authority.
...Same to you.
//Event after defeating a set number of grunts.
Teacher!
Teacher!
You no longer have any right to call me teacher.
No way!
Why not! You're still our teacher!
Eve, are you on Kei's side?
Hmph. You don't need to know.
Warning. Eve, unauthorized combat intervention\nwill be regarded as a hostile act.
[MERU] is a traitor.\nI have the right and responsibility to dispose of her.\nI believe we've already discussed this.
Ehhh!?\nA traitor... me...?
[NOEL] is a traitor.\nI have the right and responsibility to dispose of him.\nI believe we've already discussed this.
Whoa, traitor is a bit much!?
Mission partially revised.\nOnly the disposal of the target is authorized.
(Good...)
That works.\nThe rest of you are beneath my notice.
That deceitful woman!\nWhat is she thinking!
U-um...!\nIsn't something a little strange...!
Sonico-san, what's strange?
Before, when I was with Eve-san,\n[NOEL]-chan\nattacked us.
But why\nwasn't she angry back then...!
Before, when I was with Eve-san,\n[MERU]-chan\nattacked us.
But why\nwasn't she angry back then...!
If you're gonna call someone a traitor,\nthey were way more of a traitor back then!
Is she senile or is this a double standard,\nnyu?
...You don't need to understand.
I can't accept that!
That's weird, Teacher!\nYou love solving mysteries!\nSaying we don't need to understand!
//Battle resumes.\n//Talk event when Eve clashes with a heroine.
If you don't resist, you can die painlessly.
Eve's combat actions confirmed.\nClassified as an execution; will tacitly approve.
(...Good.)
T-teacher...\nwhy are you doing this?
Teacher, do you hate me that much?
Shut up and die.
Uuuu, nooo!
Ughu, n-no... I don't wanna!!
Since you ignored my orders,\nit's only natural your wishes be ignored.
That's\nmore unreasonable than my grandma!
Stubborn doesn't even begin to describe it.
//Talk event when Eve and Tsubasa clash.
Eve, can't you speak the truth?
I am speaking the truth.
If that is so,\nthen as a Sakimori, I must stop you!
I thought as much.
//Event when Eve is defeated.
Persistent, aren't you.\nIn light of that tenacity, I'll withdraw for now.
Please wait!\nWhy do we have to fight!\nAt least tell me the reason!
Hold on!\nWhat does Teacher even want!\nThis makes no sense!!
...We'll meet again.
//Eve vanishes.
Unyuu... is she hiding something...?
What the heck!? This doesn't sit right with me!!
(Strange... she said she'd kill,\nyet withdrew so easily...?)
(Perhaps Eve's goal in appearing\nwasn't [MERU]...?)
(Perhaps Eve's goal in appearing\nwasn't [NOEL]...?)
//Kei is very strong and can't be defeated. Event triggers after dealing set damage or after several turns.
She still has room to spare even after all that...!
We can't just overpower her.\nWe need another plan...
Situation check.\nNo special energy reaction detected.\nMission complete.
Huh?
Withdrawing from the combat area.
//Kei vanishes.
She ran? What does that mean?
It doesn't seem like she fled.\nShe should still have had plenty of fight left in her.
From what I could catch,\nit sounded like she left\nbecause what she wanted wasn't there?
Perhaps they came to check\nwhether we have the Angel's Tear?
Just to check?
...Probably. Kei is also... searching.
Huh, so it's hidden well enough\nthat even Kei can't find it right away.\nThis Black Trader's got skills.
//End of battle.\n//Background: town at night.
With Kei already on the move,\ngetting the Angel's Tear will be tough.
Mii might show up too,\nso I think the danger level is high.
Nacchan and I will search for the Angel's Tear.\nWe're the closest to the Black Trader,\nafter all...
Us running around\nwouldn't accomplish much anyway.
Fine, but don't try anything funny.
Understood.
So, what's the plan\nfor taking back the Angel's Tear?
You do have a plan,\ndon't you!?
...Right now, all I can say is\nplease give us time.
Hah!? Give me a break!\nYou're telling me you stole the Angel's Tear\nwithout ever thinking this could happen!?
Kurumi-san, calm down...
That's right, Kurumi-chan.\nLet's think about how\nto get the Angel's Tear back.
Hmph!
Kurumi, don't you have some tool\nfor finding the Angel's Tear, nyo?
Something that convenient\ndoesn't just pop out on demand!
Sis...
Yes. Anyway,\nwe will find the Angel's Tear.\nPlease give us time! I'm begging you!
Hmm, I don't have any better ideas right now.
So all we can do is trust\nTesla-chan and Nine-chan and wait.
...Hmph!
...Then we'll take our leave.\nWe'll definitely find the Angel's Tear and come back.
Leave it to us.
//Tesla and Nine leave.
//Fade to black.\n//Background: town (night), a slightly different spot.
Kurumi-chan, why are you so...\nabout Tesla-chan and Nine-chan...
...The Amanotsukai's duty is to protect\nthe grail shards. I think my judgment is only natural.
That's why I'm saying let's work with Tesla-chan\nand the others to find the Angel's Tear...!
They stole it, and now they're all\n"we don't know where it is but we'll look,\nand help us if we fail"!
In a crisis where the world might be destroyed,\nI can't just trust the very people who caused this\nand wait for their report!
That's... um...
Isn't it Twin Angel's duty\nto protect the grail shards\nso things like this don't happen!?
I'm sorry, Kurumi-san.\nThis all started because I\nlet the Angel's Tear be stolen from me.
It's not Onee-sama's fault!\nI'm not trying to blame\nanyone...
Sorry, Kurumi-chan...
The Amanotsukai aren't just allies of justice!\nWe protect power strong enough to destroy the world\nso it can't be misused!
We have to fulfill our duty even at the cost of our lives!\nAnd yet we're trusting those thieves and waiting-\nthat's unforgivable!
But I think it's better to leave it\nto Tesla-san and Nine-san\nthan for us to bumble around right now.
Yeah... I think so too.
...Fine.\nBut I...!
//Kurumi leaves.
Kurumi-chan!? Where are you going!!
Leave me alone!!
Kurumi-chan!!
Let's leave her be for now, Haruka-san.
But...!
Kurumi-san feels the weight\nof the Amanotsukai's duty very strongly.\nShe thinks she has to handle it herself.
Is believing in Tesla-chan and Nine-chan...\nsuch a strange thing...?
If those two hadn't returned\nthe Poketen you lost, Haruka-san,\nI might not have been able to believe in them either.
I see...
But that's exactly why\nwe have to believe in them, right?
You're right!\nBut what do we do about Kurumi-chan...?
I'm sure it'll be fine.\nThis is something Kurumi-san herself\nhas to find the answer to...
...Okay. I have to believe in Kurumi-chan\nand wait too.
Haruka, did you fight with Kurumi, nyu?
Ah, Puchiko-chan!
//Event CG: Puchiko spinning round and round.
Cheer up, nyu.\nSomething good's bound to happen, nyu.
Ehehe, are you cheering me up?
Do your best, nyu.
Thanks, Puchiko-chan!
Puchiko-san is so kind.
//Event CG off.
Something happen?\nLooks like Kurumi-chan\nwent off somewhere.
Yeah...
She fought with Haruka, nyu.
I see...\nI hope she comes back soon...
Yeah, thanks.
//Fade to black.\n//Background: night (town).
Teacher... what on earth...\nhappened to you...?
Teacher... why... why...!
Cheer up.\nI don't think Eve\nwas seriously trying to kill you.
Huh!? Really?
Then... then what is it?
At the very least, she's someone who prefers\nsolving mysteries and research over fighting and killing, no?
Maybe that wasn't true after all.
Maybe she actually likes fighting better.
If that were true, I wonder\nif she'd have bothered picking you up and raising you?
Even so...
I want to believe that, but...
If she really meant to kill,\nshe'd have come at you much more seriously.
I have no idea\nwhat Teacher's after... but,\nI want to believe there's a reason.
Yeah, if she was serious,\nsomeone like me wouldn't even be a match.\nSo... she wasn't trying to kill us?
Let's believe that.
Yes!
Yeah, you're right!
//END
